snippet.title: Inner Voice 1st person Psychological Horror Game Release Trailer
snippet.description:
You are Booker — a hunted man who lost his wife, Diana, searching for answers in a place abandoned by time and sanity. With no combat, no allies, and only your instincts to rely on, every step could be your last. And through it all, the enigmatic voice of Magnus White echoes through the darkness...

Available now on:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4139880/Inner_Voice/
GOG: https://www.gog.com/en/game/inner_voice
Epic: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/inner-voice-48e747
